_about: PLAN.md §23 WP 13.1 exit test, shared by the grid (src/lib/policies/__tests__/masterOverrides.test.ts) and the engine (sim-worker/tests/test_policies_override.py). On the Example project (dataset.json), a planner edits Material cost on the Supplier-stage row S1::M1 to 12.5. M1's other row, S3::M1, already carries a saved cost of 11 and a saved primary; S1::M1 carries a saved replenishment setting. The grid must save the edit as OVERRIDES — S1::M1 gets the cost, S3::M1 loses its cost and keeps its primary, the inventory patch is untouched — and write no item master. The engine must then use 12.5 for M1 while materials.cost stays 10.
